LanguageData.Gun_MAC-10_RWP.description: The MAC-10 is a compact, fully automatic submachine gun known for its high rate of fire. While its accuracy diminishes at longer ranges, it excels in close-quarters combat due to its lightweight frame and ease of handling. Ideal for quickly overwhelming targets in tight spaces.
